Definition: Tappuach, the name of two places in Palestine, also of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Tappuah = "the apple city"; n pr m; 1) a Judaite of the family of Caleb, son of Hebron; n pr loc; 2) a town in the lowland of Judah; 3) a town on the border in Ephraim; 4) a territory within the boundaries of Manasseh
